text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 121 vials (17.2 days on hand), Corvale General holds 140 vials (17.3 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 54 vials (24 days) of fosphenytoin sodium 50 mg/mL 10 mL vials.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include fosphenytoin sodium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 17 to 24 days of supply across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Proactive purchasing from available suppliers is warranted to maintain buffer stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as the primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as a secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA as a tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Gland Pharma Limited and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. for future allocation; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director to review inventory weekly and adjust par levels; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
